# Tecera

> Tecera is a forward-deployed commercial analytics consultancy for life sciences. Its consultants work inside the client's team, data and existing systems to turn market, field and scientific evidence into commercial decisions. Based in Bengaluru, India, with experience across EMEA, the US and India.

Tecera's Forward-Deployed Consultants combine pharma commercial context, hands-on analytics and technical delivery. Engagements start with the commercial question, use the data and tools the client already has (Excel, BI, MIDAS, Veeva, CRM, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS), and stay within the client's access controls without data migration. AI is applied only where it improves the analysis or workflow.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tecerabiz.com/): What Tecera does, working on the client's existing stack, data security and governance, and why context turns data into decisions.
- [Life Sciences](https://tecerabiz.com/life-sciences): Commercial intelligence for pharma and biotech across three evidence types (market, commercial, scientific); market research; the five service lines; how an engagement works; track record; FAQ.
- [About](https://tecerabiz.com/about): The Forward-Deployed Consultant model, what Tecera believes, team background and careers.
- [Resources](https://tecerabiz.com/resources): Anonymised case studies and practical insights on commercial analytics for life sciences.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tecerabiz.com/privacy-policy): How enquiry data submitted through the website is collected, used and protected.

## Services

- Commercial Analytics: bring data together, analyse performance and opportunity, and deliver dashboards, Excel models, automation or custom applications.
- Market and Syndicated Data Intelligence: market performance and competitive movement using MIDAS and syndicated sales data.
- Field Force and Territory Analytics: CRM, territories and field effectiveness.
- KOL and Scientific Intelligence: KOL identification, mapping and publication signals.
- Custom Built Applications: purpose-built tools for a specific commercial workflow.

## Who Tecera works with

Commercial analytics, commercial operations, market access and marketing teams at pharmaceutical and biotech companies, including rare disease, specialty care, ophthalmology and HAE.
